reason: I've never heard of this store and I can't tell from photos whether a $360 paper pendant is well made or a cheap import. I also have an electrician date, and 10 to 12 business days is already pushing it, so I'd go with a place I know that has stock close by.
objection: I can't judge the quality from photos, and with a brand I've never heard of there are no reviews or showroom I trust. If it turns out cheap, I'm paying return shipping on a big fragile box.
would_change_my_mind: Real customer reviews with photos of the actual product, a firm delivery date that beats my electrician date, and free return shipping or a cheap fabric or finish sample before I commit.
